entities.summary: Wehale, a notable figure in the history of Timor-Leste, associated with Traditional Kingdoms and Early Contacts (1200–1515). Preceded by Liurai Kingdoms and Trade Networks. Their legacy influenced Portuguese traders arrive in Timor attracted by the sandalwood trade and Portuguese Arrival.
